integrity: The claim is supported by a complete finite combinatorial proof using Euler counting and the stretch decomposition; no computational experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The identity is proved for finite tilings of convex planar polygons by nondegenerate triangles.
Infinite tilings and nonconvex regions require additional boundary terms and are not covered.
Literature searches cannot rule out an unindexed or differently phrased prior occurrence.
title: An exact shared-edge defect identity for finite triangular tilings of convex polygons
